description: This file provides a centralized token and organization ID management for client requests, including functions to get/set auth tokens, organization IDs, and build authorization headers, with legacy support for older key names.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the stored JWT token or null if not logged in.

methods.name: getOrganizationId
methods.description: Returns the active organization ID from localStorage, preferring the current key and falling back to legacy.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Legacy helper that returns the organization ID using the previous name.

methods.name: setFromLoginResponse
methods.description: Sets auth token and organization ID from login response, updating localStorage accordingly.

methods.name: setActiveOrganizationId
methods.description: Persists the active organization ID to localStorage and updates legacy key.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId
methods.description: Legacy alias for setting active organization ID.

methods.name: clearAuth
methods.description: Removes the auth token from localStorage.

methods.name: buildAuthHeaders
methods.description: Builds request headers with Authorization token if available, without tenant info.
